purpose: UI concepts for review; no app code changes
common_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptionally polished, production-believable mobile Telegram mini-app screen concept for PIXOVA, a photo/video mockup editor. Portrait 9:19.5 composition, screen UI only, no physical device bezel, no presentation board, no explanatory annotations outside the interface. Pure black app background, charcoal #1c1c1e iOS Settings grouped controls, perfectly smooth continuous corners, thin inset separators, SF Pro/system typography, restrained Telegram blue #409cff navigation and selected states, beautiful thin professional outlined icons in consistent colored rounded-square tiles. High contrast crisp readable English text, realistic 44px touch targets, generous but efficient spacing. Subtle materials, absolutely no heavy glass, no purple selection effects, no white edge artifacts. Currency is a detailed gold coin bearing a small recognizable faceted angular P logo in yellow/orange/pink; currency is credits, payments use golden Telegram Stars. Common main-page header only: left compact rounded profile pill with avatar and 'Alex' chevron, right coin pill with coin, balance, separator and +. Main pages have bottom floating charcoal capsule with home, files and settings outlined icons, no labels, active icon mint. Subpages have a simple circular back arrow, no profile header. No unsupported faster encoding claims. Use the exact requested copy, avoid extra invented marketing text.

screens.name: welcome
screens.prompt: Welcome gift onboarding on first visit. Behind a dim scrim show main Home: profile Alex, coin balance 30, wide dark upload capsule with gallery on left/video on right and centered fixed blue-violet gradient square + with small red ribbon 'Image or video', below a compact 'Recent drafts' section containing nine small square empty tiles in a 3x3 grid, bottom home-selected navigation. Foreground bottom sheet rises to mid-screen, rounded top corners and grabber, large beautiful gold P coin hovering freely with two subtle tiny coins, no border around artwork. Centered '30 credits, on us'. Single quiet line 'Photos from 2 · Videos from 5'. Wide blue 'Start creating' button. Minimal celebratory, welcoming, no subscription pitch, no long paragraphs.

screens.name: settings
screens.prompt: Main Settings page, header profile Alex and 30-credit balance kept consistent, bottom settings-selected navigation. First charcoal grouped section: 'My balance' with gold P coin icon and trailing '30' chevron, 'My subscription' with elegant premium faceted P icon and trailing 'Free' chevron. Next small inset gray group caption 'YOUR PLAN', four beautiful Settings rows: 'Photo export' trailing '2 credits'; 'Video export' trailing '5 credits'; 'High quality' trailing '+2 credits'; 'Saved drafts' trailing '0 / 5'. Native colored icon tiles and fine separators, no table appearance. Next group 'Language' with rounded English/Russian segmented switch English selected, 'Sound' native green switch on, 'Support' chevron. Separate final row 'Terms of Service'. Fit comfortably in one screen, sophisticated consistent hierarchy, no app-name title at top.

screens.name: balance
screens.prompt: Balance subpage: small back circle at top left, no main profile or coin pills, no title on top. Upper third freely floating large detailed gold P coin with a few little surrounding coins. Balance '30' immediately below coin, elegant numeral. Compact charcoal grouped benefits/cost section with three clear rows and polished colored icon tiles: 'Photo export' trailing '2 credits'; 'Video export' trailing '5 credits'; 'High quality' trailing '+2 credits'. Below, THREE equally sized compact purchase cards in a SINGLE row, gold coin above 50 / 100 / 500, subtle bottom cost capsules with official-looking golden Telegram Star and 15 / 25 / 99 respectively. No fourth option. Below a rich restrained blue-black rounded Premium banner, blue-silver faceted P icon, 'Unlimited access', small '1 month · 49 Stars', right chevron. No 'Credits' heading. Keep graceful small spacing and smooth edges.

screens.name: premium
screens.prompt: Premium subscription subpage. No main profile header, no app-name header, only small circular back arrow top left and subdued 'Not active' status pill top right. Upper section a stunning freely floating blue-silver faceted angular P emblem, modest tiny light glints, no framing box. Under it a compact tagline 'Create faster' and very small supporting text 'Every tool. One simple workflow.' This describes workflow convenience, NOT faster encoding; do NOT promise priority rendering or a speed tier. Next rounded grouped section of FOUR elegant iOS rows: 'Unlimited photos' with blue gallery tile; 'Unlimited videos' with turquoise video tile; 'High quality included' with gold HD tile; 'Unlimited drafts' with green folder tile. Below three compact equal subscription cards in ONE row: '1' / 'month' / gold Telegram Star '49'; '3' / 'months' / Star '129'; '5' / 'months' / Star '199'. Middle selected card has thin TELEGRAM BLUE highlight and tiny blue check, absolutely no purple highlights. Wide luminous restrained blue button 'Get Premium' with gold Telegram Star '129' at right. Tiny bottom secondary line 'No credits used while Premium is active'. Strong luxurious clarity, no dense paragraphs, no bottom main navigation on this subpage.

screens.name: export
screens.prompt: Video export confirmation as an iOS rounded bottom-to-middle sheet over a dim black video mockup editor. Behind sheet retain editor circular back/undo/bookmark/download actions on top, gradient canvas with realistic phone showing a generic chat UI, timeline below. Foreground sheet max about 55 percent of screen, grabber, small circular close top right. Freely displayed large charming yellow animated-sticker-like duck holding a small white document, NO border or frame around sticker. NO 'Download' header above duck, NO 'Sending to bot' text, NO format selector. Two stacked clean grouped selectable rows: 'Standard' smaller '720p' with gold P coin '5' at right; 'High quality' smaller '1080p' with gold P coin '7' at right and blue selected radio check. Small subdued line 'Balance: 30 credits'. Wide Telegram blue action button below reads 'Download' and a gold coin '7' on its right. Bottom secondary small premium link 'Unlimited exports with Premium' chevron. Clearly communicate TOTAL 7 for high quality video, not 5 plus 7. Real native polished controls, plenty of room around the duck but compact sheet.

screens.name: draft-limit
screens.prompt: Files page with a compact free-plan draft-limit bottom sheet. Main page header profile Alex and coin balance 30, no 'Files' heading. Main content a clean 3-column grid of FIVE small 1:1 saved-project thumbnails, each showing a realistic phone or free photo composition on softly colored gradient backgrounds, no literal document/file icons. Small three-dot affordance on each saved thumbnail. Bottom main nav Files icon active mint, home and settings inactive. Dim background behind a small elegant bottom sheet only lower 35 percent of screen, no full-screen purchase wall. Sheet grabber, small folder stack artwork freely displayed at top, title 'Draft limit reached', small line 'Your free plan includes 5 saved drafts.' Primary blue 'Get Premium' button with tiny infinity icon; secondary charcoal button 'Manage files'; small blue text action 'Keep editing'. Keep all existing drafts visibly intact behind it. Smooth round edges, crisp fonts, no excessive text, no scary warning styling, no fake speed promises.
